info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Cross Channel By Param1-spec
info.description: The Cross Channel Activity Analysis API provides insights into servicing activities across various banking channels based on specified parameters. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed analysis reports, which can aid in understanding customer interactions and improving service efficiency. Typical consumers of this API include data analysts and business intelligence teams looking to optimize banking operations. The API focuses on delivering comprehensive data that assists in strategic decision-making and enhances customer service delivery.
